abstract: This report covered the pathologic features, behavior, metastases, and results of transplantation of pure yolk sac carcinomas that were primary in the uterine horn of 8 mice; 6 mice were strain C3H and 2 were strain HR, and they varied from 10 to 23 months of age. Three of the mice had never been treated. Of the 5 that had, the treatment was different for each mouse. Therefore, treatment could not be correlated with tumor development. At least 5 mice were nulliparous; in fact they had never been mated, so in these some mechanism involving parthenogenesis must have been operative to account for the tumor. The tumors were identified as being primary in the uterus and occupied and distended the cavity of one uterine horn where they were polypoid or plaquelike. The neoplastic yolk cells replaced the endometrial stroma forming a support for the original endometrial glands. In time the tumor cells destroyed many of the endometrial glands. That the glands present in the primary uterine horn tumors were the original glands of the endometrium and not neoplastic glands was attested by their absence from the secondary neoplastic deposits in 4 mice in which the tumor had spread to areas outside the cavity of the uterus and from the neoplastic tissue of the tumor transplants in the recipient mice.
abstract_ja: マウス子宮角に原発した純粋な卵黄嚢癌8例について、病理学的特徴、経過、転移、移植実験の結果を報告する。対象はC3H系6匹、HR系2匹で、月齢は10〜23か月であった。3匹は未治療で、治療を受けた5匹はそれぞれ異なる治療を受けていた。そのため、治療と腫瘍発生との相関は示せなかった。少なくとも5匹は未産であり、交配歴がなかったため、これらの腫瘍には単為生殖の機序が関与していたに違いない。腫瘍は子宮角に原発し、子宮腔を占拠して拡張させており、その形態は隆起性または板状であった。腫瘍の卵黄細胞は子宮内膜間質を置換し、元の内膜腺を支持する構造を形成した。時間の経過とともに腫瘍細胞は多くの子宮内膜腺を破壊した。子宮腔外へ広がった4匹の二次性腫瘍巣には内膜腺が見られず、移植先マウスの腫瘍移植片の腫瘍組織にも存在しなかったことから、原発子宮角腫瘍に存在した腺は元の子宮内膜腺であり、新生物性の腺ではないことが確認された。
